name: Generate ship instructions in all three delivery modes
details: The emitted worker contract names the correct task data directory, permits temporary scratch, limits outside writes, and requires a clean worktree before done in no-mistakes, direct-PR and local-only modes. This checks emitted instructions, not model compliance.

name: no-mistakes: refuse clean unpushed work
details: Exit 1; unlanded commit, task branch, file bytes, and metadata are preserved.

name: no-mistakes: untracked dirt refuses without deleting work
details: Exit 1; untracked-only leftovers; all file bytes, Git status, HEAD, branch and metadata unchanged. Listing caps at ten non-exempt paths and reports overflow; repeated scratch-only cleanup also preserves everything.

name: no-mistakes: mixed dirt refuses without deleting work
details: Exit 1; includes tracked edits; all file bytes, Git status, HEAD, branch and metadata unchanged. Listing caps at ten non-exempt paths and reports overflow; repeated scratch-only cleanup also preserves everything.

name: no-mistakes: tracked dirt refuses without deleting work
details: Exit 1; includes tracked edits; all file bytes, Git status, HEAD, branch and metadata unchanged. No untracked paths are invented.

name: no-mistakes: clean landed task returns its real pool slot and retains proof
details: Ordinary cleanup exited 0 without --force or a discard decision, removed task metadata, closed the real tasks-axi backlog item, and retained every task-data proof file byte-for-byte. Real Treehouse status captured after return.
